UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd go-app-runner && rm -rf srv >/dev/null 2>&1; DownloadSource=\"{{DownloadSource}}\"; DownloadBranch=\"{{DownloadBranch}}\"; [[ -n \"{{DownloadUsername}}\" ]] && DownloadUrl=\"${DownloadSource/https:\/\//https:\/\/{{DownloadUsername}}:{{DownloadPassword}}@}\" || DownloadUrl=\"$DownloadSource\"; [ ! -d app/.git ] && { echo \"Installing the app\" && git clone \"$DownloadUrl\" srv >/dev/null && \cp -r srv/. app/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -rf srv >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd app && [ -z \"$DownloadBranch\" ] && DownloadBranch=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD | sed \"s|.*/||\"); git checkout $DownloadBranch --force >/dev/null && git pull >/dev/null && echo \"App installed\"; } || { echo \"Updating the app\" && cd app && git remote set-url origin \"$DownloadUrl\" >/dev/null && [ -z \"$DownloadBranch\" ] && DownloadBranch=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD | sed \"s|.*/||\"); git checkout $DownloadBranch --force >/dev/null && git pull >/dev/null && echo \"App updated\"; }"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; cd go-app-runner; Remove-Item srv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; $DownloadSource = \"{{DownloadSource}}\"; $DownloadBranch = \"{{DownloadBranch}}\"; if (![string]::IsNullOrEmpty(\"{{DownloadUsername}}\")) { $DownloadUrl = $DownloadSource -replace \"https://\", \"https://{{DownloadUsername}}:{{DownloadPassword}}@\" } else { $DownloadUrl = \"$DownloadSource\" }; if (-Not (Test-Path app/.git)) { Write-Output \"Installing the app\"; git clone \"$DownloadUrl\" srv 1> $null; Copy-Item srv/* app/ -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item srv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; cd app; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($DownloadBranch)) { $DownloadBranch = (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD) -replace '.*/' }; git checkout --force $DownloadBranch 1> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git pull 1> $null }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output \"App installed\" } } else { Write-Output \"Updating the app\"; cd app; git remote set-url origin \"$DownloadUrl\" 1> $null; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($DownloadBranch)) { $DownloadBranch = (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD) -replace '.*/' }; git checkout --force $DownloadBranch 1> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git pull 1> $null }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output \"App updated\" } }"

-c "GoVersion=\"{{GoVersion}}\"; GoVersion=\"${GoVersion#go}\"; cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && if [[ -x go/bin/go ]]; then InstalledVersion=$(GOTOOLCHAIN=local go/bin/go env GOVERSION 2>/dev/null); InstalledVersion=\"${InstalledVersion#go}\"; else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; if [[ -z \"$GoVersion\" ]]; then GoVersion=$(wget -qO- \"https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text\" | head -n 1); GoVersion=\"${GoVersion#go}\"; fi; if [[ ! \"$GoVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?((rc|beta)[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Go version format specified\" && exit 1; elif [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$GoVersion\" ]]; then echo \"Go $GoVersion already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; fi; rm -f go.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO go.tar.gz \"https://go.dev/dl/go$GoVersion.linux-amd64.tar.gz\" || { echo \"Go $GoVersion download failed\"; rm -f go.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 1; }; chmod -R u+w go >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf go >/dev/null 2>&1; tar -xzf go.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f go.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \"Go $GoVersion installed\""

-c "GoVersion=\"{{GoVersion}}\"; GoVersion=\"${GoVersion#go}\"; cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && if [[ -x go/bin/go ]]; then InstalledVersion=$(GOTOOLCHAIN=local go/bin/go env GOVERSION 2>/dev/null); InstalledVersion=\"${InstalledVersion#go}\"; else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; if [[ -z \"$GoVersion\" ]]; then GoVersion=$(wget -qO- \"https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text\" | head -n 1); GoVersion=\"${GoVersion#go}\"; fi; if [[ ! \"$GoVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?((rc|beta)[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Go version format specified\" && exit 1; elif [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$GoVersion\" ]]; then echo \"Go $GoVersion already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; fi; rm -f go.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO go.tar.gz \"https://go.dev/dl/go$GoVersion.linux-arm64.tar.gz\" || { echo \"Go $GoVersion download failed\"; rm -f go.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 1; }; chmod -R u+w go >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf go >/dev/null 2>&1; tar -xzf go.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f go.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \"Go $GoVersion installed\""

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $GoVersion='{{GoVersion}}' -replace '^go', ''; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullRootDir}}'; if (Test-Path 'go/bin/go.exe') { $env:GOTOOLCHAIN='local'; $InstalledVersion = ((& go/bin/go.exe env GOVERSION) -replace '^go', '').Trim() } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($GoVersion)) { $GoVersion = (((Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text') -split '\s+')[0] -replace '^go', '') }; if ($GoVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?((rc|beta)\d+)?$') { Write-Output \"Invalid Go version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ($InstalledVersion -eq $GoVersion) { Write-Output \"Go $GoVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 }; $Arch = if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE -eq 'ARM64') { 'arm64' } else { 'amd64' }; Remove-Item go.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://go.dev/dl/go$GoVersion.windows-$Arch.zip\" -OutFile go.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Go $GoVersion download failed\"; Remove-Item go.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; exit 1 }; Remove-Item go -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; tar.exe -xf go.zip; $TarExit = $LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item go.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; if ($TarExit -ne 0) { Write-Output \"Go $GoVersion extraction failed\"; exit 1 }; Write-Output \"Go $GoVersion installed\""

-c "cd go-app-runner/app/{{ApplicationLocation}} && export PATH=\"{{$FullRootDir}}go/bin:$PATH\" GOPATH=\"{{$FullRootDir}}gopath\" GOCACHE=\"{{$FullRootDir}}gocache\" GOFLAGS=\"-modcacherw\" && {{AppSetupCommands}}"

/C cd go-app-runner\app\{{ApplicationLocation}} && set "PATH={{$FullRootDir}}go\bin;%PATH%" && set "GOPATH={{$FullRootDir}}gopath" && set "GOCACHE={{$FullRootDir}}gocache" && set "GOFLAGS=-modcacherw" && go build -o "{{ApplicationName}}.exe" {{BuildArgs}} {{BuildTarget}} && echo App built
